papers.title: AdaptEvo: Adaptive Agent Learning with Evolving Supervision
papers.summary: Targets rule-based decision tasks where written rules leave gaps and reference labels may disagree with the evidence. Confidence-Adaptive GRPO weights outcome and process rewards by label confidence, while an evolution loop distills reusable decision knowledge from recurring failures and refines rubrics. On Qwen3.6-35B-A3B it beats GRPO by 7.5 points in exact-label accuracy and holds up under changed rules where GRPO degrades.

papers.title: A Survey of Agentic Reasoning for Large Language Models: Towards Recursively Self-Improving and Collective Agents
papers.summary: Organizes agentic reasoning into three layers: single-agent planning and tool use, self-evolving agents that learn from feedback and memory, and collective multi-agent reasoning. It contrasts in-context reasoning with post-training (RL, SFT) approaches and covers applications and open challenges such as long-horizon interaction, world modeling and governance. Accepted at TMLR.
